description: Second slice. Add a durable StructFieldExpectation/StructReference obligation store mirroring InterfaceExpectation/InterfaceRequester{code,module,span}, validated on StructDefined settle at requester spans. Migrate resolve.rs TypeExpr::StructRecord to record A.field obligations and wait/read StructDefined(A) when precise schema/order is needed -- it must NOT silently drop unknown fields (current bug). Test (ticket #3): type-expression @type t :: %A{field: integer} records A.field, waits/reads StructDefined(A), unknown fields diagnosed not dropped. Needs the StructDef store from the first slice.
title: Structs: obligation store + validate-on-settle; migrate resolve.rs TypeExpr::StructRecord
